title: centaurium erythraea subsp. boissieri
intro: Centaurium erythraea subsp. boissieri, commonly known as mountain centaury, is a plant species belonging to the gentian family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of mountain centaury are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in mountain centaury include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
